verdict.rationale: LangGraph's Pregel/BSP execution model supports parallelism across nodes without data races, which could underpin fan-out/bulk processing of items, and community notes 'built-in parallelism' — but there is no explicit documentation of a batch/map-reduce API (e.g., Send-style fan-out) or examples of processing large item collections in bulk. missing for 10: explicit batch/bulk API documentation, examples of iterating/mapping over many items, evidence of scaling behavior for large item counts.
